fact: The Presidency of the Government says it launched the online platform e-Mouaten (e-people.gov.tn), through which citizens report in real time obstacles met with the administration and follow the handling of their requests, with no case figures given.
Tunisia's e-people civil petition and corruption reporting platform was in a pilot phase linked to ten government bodies, with no reports yet available, per the IRM.
The Médiateur Administratif says citizens can submit petitions through its website, a mobile app and its social network, and that 95 petitions came in through electronic channels in 2020.

The Médiateur Administratif publishes statistics from its 2020 annual report on files handled centrally, with 51% answered, 49% unanswered and 38% still being followed up, broken down by type of body.
